blocks.text: The M&E toolkit turns this chapter into four working files that Wesgro Research owns from handover.

The four files are the indicator register, the baseline workbook, the scorecard template and the dashboard data model (SLA clauses 1.1.10.2 and 1.1.15.3) [clause wording to be checked against the signed Annexure B]. The indicator register holds all 72 indicators with their definition, unit, source, frequency, owner, baseline and target by year and path. The baseline workbook holds the baseline values with page references to the deliverables, and the computed values with their method. Wesgro Research owns both. The programme office owns the scorecard template, which carries the quarterly Steerco scorecard and the annual Board outlook. It also owns the dashboard data model: the feeds, refresh frequency and manual-entry forms for the dashboard in section 5.5.

Handover runs through knowledge-transfer sessions with Wesgro Research and the programme office, as the SLA requires (clause 1.1.15). The Excel toolkit itself is outside this report and is listed as an open item [M&E toolkit workbook: Letsema to deliver with the final report].
